text:
leo_sales: Heads up — HelioAI (pre-seed, security tooling) asked for an extended evaluation: 120 days + $25k usage credit + white-glove onboarding. They said token usage will spike during index runs. Can we do this under special approval?

tara_ae: short context: product team expects enterprise interest but ARR likely low first 6mo. They need longer runway because SOC2 timelines pushed by their infra vendor.

devin_se: tech note: they want to enable embeddings + reranking at scale. Ask includes ephemeral KV snapshot access and priority routing during demo windows. No on-prem required — hosted only.

emma_dealdesk: standard program = 60d + $10k for startup tier. Anything over needs deal desk sign-off with conversion metrics and exec sponsor. Provide ARR conversion forecast and reference list.

leo_sales: provisional business case included: 1) projected ARR 12mo = $120k if pilot converts; 2) partner path with 2 pilots lined up; 3) founder ref from accelerator. Requesting 120d + $25k + two onboarding engineer-days.

omar_finance: finance rules: approvals needed if credit >$15k. Credits treated as contra-revenue unless they convert within 6mo (rebate clause). Need CAC payback estimate and billing cadence after pilot.

lina_infosec: infosec: for hosted SAML + embeddings we need an SCC + IdP metadata. We can permit an evaluation with retention limited to 45 days and redaction of SSNs/PII. Any longer retention needs DPA and security review. Also need to confirm no export of raw training data.

devin_se: operationally, priority routing can be granted for limited windows but require ops scheduling. KV snapshot: can provide read-only snapshot during demo, no long-term persistence.

legal-bot: legal checklist: DPA, standard indemnity retention, and an addendum for trial exceptions. If you want custom indemnity, route to legal counsel.

emma_dealdesk: deal desk offer we can approve now: 120d trial + $15k credit + 1 onboarding day (engineer), retention 45d, and ops priority for up to 4 demo sessions. If sales accepts, we approve; otherwise escalate for VP signoff.

leo_sales: customer insists $25k to cover index runs. Proposed compromise: $15k now + contingent $10k rebate credited if they sign a >=$75k ARR commit within 4 months of pilot end. Clawback terms?

omar_finance: finance ok with contingent rebate if clause: (i) invoices paid, (ii) commit signed and effective, (iii) credits applied only against pre-conversion usage and rebate paid as invoice credit after commit. Must be time-limited (4 months). Finance will mark contra-revenue accordingly.

lina_infosec: security approves the 45d retention + SAML. Will require IdP metadata and SCC before provisioning. No PII exports allowed during trial.

devin_se: will coordinate ops windows; please create PILOT ticket.

leo_sales: will update business case with contingent language and send CMA. Also ask legal for expedited DPA template.

legal-bot: DPA request received — legal will push the standard trial addendum to the thread and cc sales.

emma_dealdesk: summary: if updated doc includes contingent $10k rebate tied to >=$75k ARR commit in 4 months and finance/clawback language included, deal desk approves $15k credit + 1 onboarding day + ops priority. Escalate if customer still insists on upfront $25k.

leo_sales: Thanks — I'll run the compromise by HelioAI now and update here. Ticket created: PILOT-4901 (ops scheduling queued). :thumbsup:
